row.notes: Two callers. 0x1434be460 (call 0x1434be69e; the state 10/11 hold-in-garage alignment, called from Game_PitLane_UpdateMovement at 0x1434b9199 for state 10 and 0x1434b92c6 for state 11) passes the pit lane record +0xe0 as box unchecked. Game_Pitlane_ApplyVehicleResetState 0x1434c03c0 (call 0x1434c0493, case 4 of jump table 0x145845cc8) passes [entry+0xe0] after a signed <= 0x17 check, so 99 stops there and -1 passes. Reads the cache slot at mgr+0x7f8+box*8 (0x1434c3656), which holds a zone key: the 0x1445f32a0 result on [[mgr+0x18]+0x28] at the box position, a pointer to a 0x140-byte zone record or 0, which 0x140679340 only hashes (FNV-1a, 0x14063bc89) into the spline's segment buckets and never dereferences, so a wrong non-null value misses and falls back to the full search 0x140679410; null results are stored too, so a miss repeats, and stores the lookup result there on every miss (0x1434c36a6), with no bound on box. Game_PitLane_GenerateSplines 0x1434ca550 zeroes 24 slots (0x7f8..0x8b7); 14 tuning handles follow at +0x8b8..+0x920, and 27 16-byte {allocator, record pointer} entries run from +0x930 to +0xadf (bound at 0x1434b51cc), so the first record pointer is at mgr+0x938. -1 (a third car in a garage has no box) faults at 0x1434c3656 (mov r8,[rbx+r14*8+0x7f8], mgr+0x8000007f0). 99 reads mgr+0xb10, a subsystem pointer that 0x1434b59b0 sets at 0x1434b5b6a: a non-null one goes to 0x1434c5c90 as the key, and a null one is overwritten with a zone pointer at 0x1434c36a6. The reset 0x1434b5110 sets +0xe0 to 0x7fffffff for every car (0x1434b56bc), which the unchecked caller passes through. Returns false (cmp edi,2 at 0x1434c4202, setne al at 0x1434c4205) when 0x1434c5c90 returns 2, with out untouched; 0x1434be460 then leaves the car alone and 0x1434c03c0 takes its error path (0x1434c04a0). focus325 and simon_92216 1.6.12 crashes. Needs L2 promotion by the game owner.
